title: Streaming mean and variance (Welford)
summary: Update a running mean and variance one value at a time, merge the states of two data parts, and stay accurate for values with a huge offset.

mutants.update_stale_mean: Multiplies delta by itself and not by the distance to the new mean.
mutants.merge_missing_weight: Leaves out the division by n in the correction term of m2.
mutants.merge_mean_unweighted: Averages the two means without weighting them by their counts.
mutants.merge_no_empty_guard: Divides by zero when both states are empty.
mutants.finalize_always_sample: Always divides by n - 1 and ignores ddof.
